name: AdGuard Home
description: The updater polls version information, downloads the package into an update directory, and replaces the current executable with the downloaded one. VersionInfo contains no digest or signature field, and downloadPackageFile writes the response body directly; the source therefore supports the recorded narrow unauthenticated package-update behavior.
limitations: The inspected source snapshot does not establish release artifact provenance beyond transport defaults.
Snapshot is a newly retrieved default branch, not the historical study revision.
